title: SPH sculpt
description: An island of plasticine you can dig into and build up, with a spring whose SPH water runs downhill through whatever you carve. The clay is ray traced from a distance field, with soft shadows and occlusion under a golden-hour sky. Only the blocks around the water rebuild its surface as it moves.
line: Dig channels in clay and the spring water finds its way downhill.
hint: drag to dig · hold Shift to build · right-drag to orbit · wheel to zoom
